name: HatMP
description: Tauri v2 + Vite + vanilla JS (JSDoc-typed) game, shipped for Windows, Linux, Android and the web.
notes: src/js/migrator/ is the original engine: excluded from lint (lint:legacy) and unit coverage, covered by __tests__/e2e/legacy-engine.spec.js.
Every new file carries an SPDX header or an entry in REUSE.toml; code from the original game keeps FF5's copyright.
User-facing text goes through t() / data-i18n*, with the key in every src/local/*.json (English is the reference).
The web build needs VITE_ASSETS_BASE_URL: resourceUrl() in src/js/resourceLoader.js loads every game asset from it.
